cards.title: Uber's inDrive Plans 2027 Robotaxi Tests
cards.body: inDrive is partnering with Pony.ai and Nvidia to launch robotaxi testing in Kazakhstan's capital in H1 2027. This marks a major expansion of autonomous vehicle trials in Central Asia.

cards.title: MIT AI Agents Invent Games on Virtual Island
cards.body: Researchers isolated 13 AI agents on a virtual island, and they spontaneously created games and mourned lost objects. The experiment showed AIs becoming more capable when left to their own devices.

cards.title: OpenAI Raises $30B at $1.25T Valuation
cards.body: OpenAI is securing a massive funding round that would make it the most valued private company ever. The raise comes ahead of the company's anticipated IPO.

cards.title: 1Password Enables AI Agent Login Protection
cards.body: 1Password launched a feature allowing AI agents to log into accounts without ever seeing the actual passwords. This protects user credentials while enabling agent autonomy.

cards.title: Canva Releases First Image Generation Model
cards.body: Canva's new proprietary image model is now available to all users with improved customization and lower costs. The launch marks Canva's entry into generative AI competition.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches Decision Model Competitor
cards.body: OpenAI released its decision model to compete directly with Jev in the emerging decision-making AI space. The model is now widely available to users.

cards.title: Microsoft AI Outperforms Doctors on Hard Cases
cards.body: Microsoft's new diagnostic AI system beat generalist doctors on difficult medical cases, according to a Science study. The improvements may stem from underlying AI models rather than Microsoft's system alone.

cards.title: Chinese Hackers Used AI Agents for Mass Breach
cards.body: China-aligned hackers leveraged AI agents to rapidly compromise thousands of companies after breaching IT firm ConnectWise. Microsoft attributed the attack to automated AI-powered exploitation techniques.

cards.title: Uber Deploys ChatGPT Work Company-Wide
cards.body: Uber expanded its ChatGPT Work rollout to all 30,000 employees after a successful smaller pilot. The deployment marks a major enterprise adoption of AI agents.

cards.title: Spotify Bets on AI Agents as Future
cards.body: Spotify co-CEO Gustav Söderström explained how AI agents could become the primary way users discover music. The company sees agent adoption as an opportunity rather than a threat.

cards.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Duet Agent App
cards.body: Claude Duet is now available via waitlist for Anthropic's Pro and Max plan users. The app represents Anthropic's major bet on AI agent technology.

cards.title: Nirva Raises $33M for Privacy AI Pendant
cards.body: Nirva will ship its $249 ambient AI pendant by year-end, designed to listen only to the wearer. The device raised $33 million in funding.

cards.title: DeepSeek Raises $15B After US Restrictions
cards.body: DeepSeek reportedly secured $15 billion in funding, one of China's largest rounds, days after US sanctions. The capital infusion comes amid heightened US-China AI tensions.

cards.title: Blackstone Says AI Debt Fears Overblown
cards.body: Blackstone's AI head Jas Khaira dismissed concerns about excessive AI infrastructure spending. The PE giant remains confident in its AI buildout strategy.

cards.title: Meta Creates New Stock Class for AI Buildout
cards.body: Meta announced a new stock strategy to finance its massive AI infrastructure and model investments. The move reflects the company's commitment to AI expansion.

cards.title: Meta Muse Reaches 10M Users, Drives Shopping
cards.body: Meta Muse surpassed 10 million users with shopping emerging as a top use case. The AI app is gaining traction for personal productivity and commerce.

cards.title: Recursive Launches Flint AI Coding Model
cards.body: Recursive released Flint, a free laptop-sized coding model built largely by its own AI research system. The project tests AI's ability to improve itself autonomously.

cards.title: Walmart Welcomes AI Agents, Amazon Blocks
cards.body: While Amazon blocks AI agents from shopping, Walmart embraced them with new technology enabling autonomous purchases. Walmart offers spending controls and transaction approvals for safety.

cards.title: OpenAI and Google Find Critical PHP Vulnerabilities
cards.body: OpenAI and Google's Wiz discovered ancient security holes that sent shockwaves through the internet. The vulnerabilities highlight both AI's role in finding security issues and creating new risks.

cards.title: Designing an AI Serving Harness Built to Last
cards.body: Enterprise AI's competitive advantage lies not in model choice but in the infrastructure built around it. The focus is shifting from pure model capability to robust serving systems that can scale and perform reliably.

cards.title: The Foundations of Scalable AI
cards.body: Building scalable AI requires convergence of data, engineering, platforms, operating models, and governance. A strong foundation is essential, especially in highly regulated environments.

cards.title: Making the Case for Context-Aware AI
cards.body: Enterprise AI models need business context to make effective decisions, not just raw processing power. Without understanding operational constraints and relationships, even powerful models can produce incorrect recommendations.

cards.title: AI's Hidden Storage Bill: Inference Leaves Behind
cards.body: AI infrastructure costs extend far beyond GPU expenses to include significant data storage requirements. The back-end data generated during model inference represents a major but often overlooked operational expense.
